mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM psp_route_rule r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.country_code = #{countryCode} AND r.currency = #{currency} AND r.method_code = #{methodCode} AND r.direction = #{direction} AND r.status = #{status} AND (r.merchant_id IS NULL OR r.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) AND (r.merchant_app_id IS NULL OR r.merchant_app_id = #{merchantAppId}) AND (r.min_amount IS NULL OR r.min_amount <= #{amount}) AND (r.max_amount IS NULL OR r.max_amount >= #{amount}) AND ( r.start_time IS NULL OR r.end_time IS NULL OR r.start_time = r.end_time OR (r.start_time < r.end_time AND #{nowTime} >= r.start_time AND #{nowTime} <= r.end_time) OR (r.start_time > r.end_time AND (#{nowTime} >= r.start_time OR #{nowTime} <= r.end_time)) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.merchant_app_id = #{merchantAppId} THEN 0 WHEN r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.merchant_app_id IS NULL THEN 10 WHEN r.merchant_id IS NULL AND r.merchant_app_id IS NULL THEN 20 ELSE 100 END ASC, COALESCE(r.priority, 100) ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT 1
